text:
incident-bot: ALERT — realtime SLO breach detected in us-west-2 streaming. p95 jumped to 520ms (baseline ~130ms), p99 to 2200ms. Streaming stalls count: 112 in last 5m. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alerts/3259995317 :rotating_light:

alice: ack — I'm on it. paging SRE oncall: @bob

bob: I'm here. pulling up graphs now. Any visible customer errors? @dave can you scan CS for hits?

carol: kvcache evictions spike at ~10:13:40 UTC. Also seeing a surge of many small-batch requests from inference-router -> streaming backpressure.

bob: running quick logs: `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=streamer -c runtime --since=10m | grep -i "timeout\|evict"`

bob: logs show repeated "write timeout" and "kvcache miss" entries. No OOMs.

alice: can we do a partial route-shift to eu for the affected shard as mitigation?

carol: initiating 10% route override to eu for shard s-42 now. infra-bot will post status.

infra-bot: Route override applied: shard=s-42 -> eu (10%). Monitoring metrics for 5m windows.

carol: p95 improves to ~360ms after 2m on the canary -> good signal.

bob: p99 still elevated (~1200ms). Proposing quick config: decrease batch_size on us-west pool to 8. Command: `/runops change-batch --pool usw2-streamers --batch-size 8`

emma: applying batch_size change now, will monitor KV hit rate and latency.

dave: CS update — 3 new tickets referencing "streaming timeout" and 1 priority customer reported degraded UX. Notified AMs.

alice: plan: 1) monitor 15m for p99 improvement; 2) if p99 not down by 30% then failover shard -> eu; 3) prepare postmortem template and RCA owner. React with :thumbsup: when you have console open.

bob: 👍 p95 trending down to 210ms, p99 to ~950ms. KV hit rate recovering.

carol: root looks like a recent TTL change in kvcache PR — evictions spiked when rollover happened. Opening revert PR: https://git.redwood/pr/8765

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2025-042-3259995317 and pinned to #incidents. Pager cleared from oncall after ack.

alice: keeping this thread as primary coordination. Will post final status in 15m unless we escalate. Thanks team.
